about.text: I have helped more than a thousand patients from all over Europe. Many come back to me for further treatment and recommend me to their families and friends. Your health matters most to me.

faq.title: Questions
faq.intro: Can't find your question? Message me and I'll reply within 24 hours.

items.q: How much does your help cost?
items.a: Nothing for you. The consultation and my care are free. You only pay for treatment and your stay, according to the quote you receive before you travel.

items.q: Why are there no clinic names on the website?
items.a: I work with many clinics and hospitals in Istanbul and choose the doctor for each patient. After the consultation I tell you exactly where and with whom you will be treated.

items.q: How long will I stay in Istanbul?
items.a: It depends on the treatment. You receive a day-by-day plan for your stay after the consultation.
Citizens of most EU countries, including Poland, can stay in Turkey visa-free for up to 90 days. If you are not sure about your country, ask me.

items.q: Can I bring someone with me?
items.a: Of course. About half of my patients come with someone close to them.
Polish, Ukrainian, Russian and Turkish, and some English. At the clinic I interpret every conversation with the doctor.

items.q: What if something worries me after I get home?
items.a: Message me. We stay in touch after you return, and if needed I pass your questions on to the doctor.

items.q: When do you reply to messages?
items.a: Within 24 hours, Monday to Saturday. On Sundays I rest.
